files.purpose: TimelineRows.swift holds the SwiftUI view for every kind of row the chat transcript can show. It covers the user's iMessage-style bubble with its quote chips, pencil editor and 'Edit from this message?' revert dialog; the Hydra team rows (head report pill, lead brief pill with the cooking shimmer, finished-head pills, the streamed delegation card, the merge pill with its animated dot track); attachment strips and thumbnails; assistant replies with their right-click action list; collapsible tool work groups, individual tool rows that open a diff, an image, a head's steps popover or inline output; the plan badge, todo checklist, notice row, turn-end duration line, and the collapsed finished-turn block with its edited-files card and revert/review round buttons. It also owns the shared vertical geometry (TimelineMetrics) and the pure text helpers the rows use: tool labels and verbs (ToolPresentation), the work-group summary sentence (WorkGroupSummary), Hydra report summaries, merge-note URL parsing and the last-fenced-code-block scan used by 'Copy last code block'.

side_effects: Writes to the system pasteboard (NSPasteboard.general clearContents + setString, reflowed via ProseReflow) for 'Copy message', 'Copy as markdown', 'Copy last code block'.
Sets runtime.messageEdit (open/close the message editor); hovering the pencil calls runtime.revertPreview(for: turnID) to start the file preview early.
Starts async runtime.revert(to: turnID, restoreFiles:) from the user row dialog (false or true) and from the turn file card (always restoreFiles: true); errors are swallowed with try?.
Appends a ReplyQuote(text:) to runtime.draft.quotes for 'Add to reply' unless a quote with the same text already exists.
Calls runtime.showDiff(...) to open the changes popover, AttachmentPreviewSlot.panel.toggle(...) to open image preview panels, runtime.implementPlan(entry.id) / runtime.dismissPlan(entry.id).
Opens URLs in the browser through SwiftUI Link (merge request links, label 'Open').
Warms MarkdownView parsing off the main thread (.task) for report/merge popovers.
Loads thumbnails via ThumbnailCache.shared and stores into ThumbnailMemory.

TurnFinishedBlock .task(id: turnID): when summary.changes == nil and (summary.filesChanged > 0 or the turn has edits), awaits runtime.parsedDiff(selection: turnID), then `guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }` (2711), then builds FileChangeSummary(files:), keeps it in legacyChanges and persists it via runtime.storeLegacyChanges(changes, turnID: turnID).
Calls revealBox?.action() (revealTimelineEnd) when expanding a work group, showing all steps, expanding a tool row's output, or expanding a finished turn.

AttachmentStrip and ToolRow both close their image preview panel when the row leaves the screen: `.onDisappear { [weak slot] in slot?.close() }` (1231 and 1715). The strip also installs `.background { AttachmentAnchorCapture { [weak slot] in slot?.setAnchor($0) } }` (1228-1230), the anchor that anchorless thumbnails aim their panel at.

Files popover: up to 12 rows (path callout 1 line middle truncation, 'Binary' caption secondaryText or DiffStatLabel), padding h12 v7; overflow line 'and 1 more file' when exactly 13 else 'and \(count - 12) more files' callout secondaryText.
feature_notes: UserMessageRow dispatch order: message.isFromHydra -> HydraReportRow; else message.isHydraBrief -> HydraBriefRow; else the bubble. isEditing = entry.turnID != nil && runtime.messageEdit?.id == entry.turnID. The pencil toggles runtime.messageEdit between nil and PromptEdit(id: turnID, text: message.text, attachments: message.attachments). The editor syncs on anchor capture and on isEditing change and closes on disappear.

Right-click on a user message builds its actions from snapshots; 'Copy message' copies MessageText.plain(text), 'Copy as markdown' copies raw text; both go through ProseReflow.reflowed. 'Edit from here' only sets menuRequests.confirmRevert, which the row resets and turns into isConfirmingRevert = true. Revert runs Task { _ = try? await runtime.revert(to:restoreFiles:) }.

lastCodeBlock scans lines split on "\n": each line with prefix ``` toggles open/closed; a closed block's lines joined by "\n" become the candidate; an unclosed trailing block is ignored; the last closed block wins.

HydraReportRow: personas = (message.hydraHeads ?? []).map(HydraRoster.persona(at:)). With no personas (a note from Hydra itself): text split at the first newline (maxSplits 1, empty subsequences omitted); title = first line minus one trailing '.', default 'Hydra'; body = remainder trimmed; link = leadingURL(body); details = body, or body without its first line when a link was found. With personas: title = reportSummary, body = full text, no link.

reportSummary: names with no '(failed' / '(stopped' outcome are listed as '\(list) is done' (1) or 'are done' (more); each other head adds '\(name) failed' or '\(name) stopped'; joined with ', ' and passed through TextCleanup.singleLine(limit: 140). list(): '' for none, 'A' for one, 'A, B and C'. reportOutcomes reads lines trimmed of whitespace starting '## ' with a ':'; name = characters 3..<colon trimmed; lowercased text from the colon containing '(failed' -> 'failed', else '(stopped' -> 'stopped'.

leadingURL: first line trimmed of spaces must start (case-insensitively) with 'http://' or 'https://' and contain no whitespace, then URL(string:). withoutFirstLine returns '' when there is no newline, else everything from the first newline, trimmed.

Report pill popover choice: link + MergeRequestLink(url:) + HydraMergeNote.parse(details, link:) -> HydraMergePopover; else personas -> HydraReportsPopover(title:text:personas:); else HydraReportPopover(text: body). The button is disabled and does nothing when details is empty. .task(id: body) warms markdown for [body] or each head body from HydraReportDigest.parse(body).heads.

HydraHeadsWorkingRow reads model.helpers(of: runtime.threadID) filtered by isHydraHead, indexes their hydra infos by index (first wins), and shows a FinishedHeadPill for each requested index found, in the caller's order. finishedHeads(in:) returns [] when no head is running; otherwise finished heads whose batch still has a running head, or (no batchID) whose finishedAt >= earliest running startedAt.
FinishedHeadPill accessibility title: '\(name) failed' (.failed), '\(name) was stopped' (.stopped), '\(name) finished working' (otherwise); opens HydraHeadReportPopover(head:).

HydraBriefRow: persona = runtime.thread?.hydra?.persona ?? HydraRoster.persona(at: 0). hasOutput = the entry has a turnID and another entry (different id) shares it; memoized per runtime.entries.count via onChange(of: count, initial: true). cooking = !hasOutput && runtime.isRunning. Popover HydraBriefPopover(persona:, task: runtime.thread?.hydra?.task, text: message.text).

HydraDelegationBlock: reading = HydraPrompts.streamedDelegations(inBody: json[...]) cached in a 200-entry RecentCache keyed by the JSON string; streaming = !reading.isComplete && !sent. persona(named:) returns nil for nil/blank names, else HydraRoster.persona(named:). projectName: nil for nil/blank; a value containing '/' becomes its lastPathComponent (falls back to the whole value if that is empty).

HydraMergeOutcome parses the outcome note exactly like a Hydra note: title via withoutTrailingStop(first line ?? 'Hydra'), body = rest trimmed, link = leadingURL(body), details = body or body minus first line.

HydraMergeRow: while phase is .merging and runtime.isHydraMerging is false the row renders EmptyView (the pill goes away). Track step = runtime.hydraMergeStep?.rawValue ?? 0 while running, else HydraMergeStage.allCases.count - 1. trackMode: no outcome -> .running; outcome with flourish -> .done; else .resting. flourish turns on when isMerging goes true -> false and outcome.title contains 'Hydra merged', and off again after Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(1100)). Tapping the track or title toggles the report popover (arrowEdge .bottom, presentedChrome) only when details is non-empty. Popover content (1113-1119): when outcome.link, MergeRequestLink(url:) and HydraMergeNote.parse(outcome.details, link:) all succeed it shows HydraMergePopover(note:); otherwise the fallback is HydraReportPopover(text: outcome.body), the full body including any leading URL line, not details.

HydraMergeTrackBody math: trackWidth = count*4 + (count-1)*3; dotCentre(i) = i*7 + 2; lit(i) = max(position + 0.35 >= i ? 1 : 0, clamp(done*(count+1) - i, 0, 1)); side = 12 + 6*rest; x = (dotCentre(position) - 6)*(1 - rest); y = -arc*(1 - rest) + 1*rest; frame width = trackWidth + (18 - trackWidth)*rest, height 20, topLeading.

AttachmentThumbnail: first state image comes from ThumbnailMemory (so revisited photos do not fade in); .task(id: path) uses ThumbnailMemory else ThumbnailCache.shared.thumbnail(for:pointSize:fillingSquare: true), stores it, fades in with easeOut 0.15. Anchor view is mounted only after the first hover and never when anchorless. togglePanel uses the slot's lazily created panel or the caller's coordinator.
AssistantMessageRow 'Add to reply' ignores the request if runtime.draft.quotes already has a quote with identical text; runtime is captured weakly.
WorkGroup: a single entry renders a bare ToolRow. startsCollapsed changes only ever collapse (one-way). WorkSteps hides all but the last 2 entries until 'N earlier steps' is tapped.

WorkGroupSummary.text: one pass records per kind whether any call is running; parts in order edit, read, command, search, web, mcp, agent, other with labels Editing/Edited files, Reading/Read files, Running/Ran commands, Searching/Searched, Browsing/Browsed, Calling/Called tools, Delegating/Delegated tasks, Using/Used tools; 'Worked' when no tool entries; parts after the first get a lowercased first character; joined by ', '. symbol(for:) returns the symbol of the first kind present in that order, default 'wrench.and.screwdriver'.

ToolRow logic: edits = call.edits with non-empty path; opensDiff = edits non-empty; imagePath resolved only when not a diff; showsOutput = !opensDiff && (output non-empty || detail non-empty); opensImage = imagePath != nil && (kind == .read || !showsOutput); headID = runtime.hydraHead(forTool: entry.id) for .agent calls; not tappable rows render as plain text. Tap: head -> toggle steps popover; diff -> runtime.showDiff(on: anchor, edge: .minY, turn:, focusEdits: edits); image -> panel toggle with PreviewImages.attachment(for:) at edge .minY; else toggle inline output with .snappy(0.24) and reveal.

Head text for linked agent calls: '\(running ? "Sending out" : "Sent out") \(persona.name): \(call.title)'. departingHead: title trimmed; if 'Name: task' and Name is a roster persona -> (persona, persona.name, task) (1731): the roster's canonical name, not the text typed before the colon; else (persona at 0, nil, title unless it is one of 'subagent', 'agent', 'task', '' (case-insensitive) in which case ''). departureLabel: running 'Sending out \(who)\(rest)', failed 'Could not send out \(who)\(rest)', else 'Sent out \(who)\(rest)' with who = name ?? 'a head' and rest = ': \(task)' or ''. departureStatus: running nil, failed .failed, else .completed.

ToolPresentation.label strips a leading word equal to a kind root: command [run, bash, shell, exec, execute, command], read [read, view, open, cat], edit [edit, write, multiedit, create, notebookedit, apply_patch, patch], search [search, grep, glob, find], web [fetch, webfetch, websearch, browse], mcp [call], agent [delegate, agent, task], other [use]; then joins verb + subject with a space, dropping empty parts. Verbs: Running/Ran, Reading/Read, Editing/Edited, Searching/Searched, Browsing/Browsed, Calling/Called, Delegating/Delegated, Using/Used. stats returns nil when no edits or additions+deletions == 0. mcpParts splits the title at ' · ' (space, middle dot, space), both sides trimmed and non-empty, and needs MCPCatalog.entry(matching: server). mcpLabel = '\(entry.name): \(tool)' (running is unused).

HydraHeadStepsPopover: report shown only when the head isFinished and its summary trimmed is non-empty. statusLine = outcome ('Working…', 'Done', 'Failed', 'Stopped') + ('1 tool' or '\(n) tools' when toolCalls > 0) + RelativeTime.duration(finishedAt.timeIntervalSince(hydra.startedAt)) whenever `if let finishedAt = hydra.finishedAt` (2021-2023), not gated on isFinished (only the report section uses isFinished, 1888), joined ' · '. steps(in:) drops the first user entry (the brief), keeps later user entries and assistant entries with non-blank text, keeps all tool and notice entries, drops reasoning, turnEnd, plan, todos.

ToolDetailView: output trimmed of newlines; lineCount = 1 + number of 0x0A bytes; collapsed when not expanded and lineCount > 30, showing the text before the 30th newline (head(of:lines:) scans UTF-8 bytes).
DiffDetailCache keys on path + "\n" + diff and parses with DiffParser.parseHunks(diff, path:), 60-entry cache.

PlanCard proposed buttons: 'Implement plan' closes the popover then runtime.implementPlan(entry.id); 'Dismiss' closes then runtime.dismissPlan(entry.id); both disabled when runtime.pendingPlanApproval != nil || runtime.isRunning.

TurnEndRow.label: '.completed' and '.running' -> 'Worked for \(duration)', '.interrupted' -> 'Stopped after \(duration)', '.failed' -> 'Failed after \(duration)', duration from RelativeTime.duration(summary.duration).

TurnFinishedBlock.Derived: assistant entries with any non-whitespace character go into assistantEntries and answerEntries (hasResponse = true); plans into collapsedPlans; non-info notices into collapsedNotices; each tool entry clears answerEntries, adds .agent calls to headEntries and sets hasEdits when edits exist. If answerEntries ends empty the last assistant entry is used. Plans or non-info notices also set hasResponse. When expanded, detailGroups = TimelineGroup.build(content, showReasoning: false) minus .heads groups. The derivation is memoized in @State after render via onChange(of: key, initial: true).

TurnFinishedBlock body: changes = summary.changes ?? legacyChanges; showsBody = showsHeads || hasFiles || (expanded ? detailGroups non-empty : hasResponse). Divider and all content appear only when showsBody. Expanded: groups rendered as AssistantMessageRow (summary nil), single-tool WorkGroup, PlanCard, TodoListRow, NoticeRow or multi-entry WorkGroup with its startsCollapsed; folded: FoldedAnswerView for answer entries with non-empty text, then plans, then error/warning notices. Heads list always below; TurnFileCard last with onRevert = revert(to: turnID, restoreFiles: true).
TurnFileCard revert requires confirmation popover; Review button needs its NSView anchor (captured after first hover) and returns silently when none.

B1->B2: 2878 -> 2859 lines (git diff: 103 insertions, 122 deletions). (1) The chat zoom environment was removed from this file: 18 declarations of '@Environment(\.chatZoom) private var zoom' (HydraReportRow, FinishedHeadPill, HydraBriefRow, HydraDelegationBlock, HydraMergeRow, AssistantMessageRow, WorkGroup, WorkSteps, ToolRow, HydraHeadStepsPopover, ToolStatusIcon, ToolDetailView, PlanCard, TodoListRow, NoticeRow, TurnEndRow, TurnFinishedBlock, TurnFileCard) and the '.environment(\.chatZoom, 1)' on HydraReportPopover; all 59 '.chat(..., zoom: zoom)' call sites (on 58 lines; B1 line 1802 had two: `.font(isBadge ? .chat(.callout, weight: .medium, zoom: zoom) : .chat(.callout, zoom: zoom))`) became '.chat(...)' without the zoom argument (B2 line 1791). This is a behaviour change, not just a signature change: B1's Font.chat(_:weight:design:zoom:) in DroppyCode/UI/Common/ChatZoom.swift (deleted in B2, 71 lines) returned Font.system(size: (chatBaseSize(style) * zoom).rounded(), weight: resolvedWeight ?? .regular, design:) when zoom != 1; B2's new DroppyCode/UI/Common/ChatFont.swift:6-9 defines `Font.chat(_ style:weight:design:)` as Font.system(style, design:) with weight ?? (style == .headline ? .semibold : nil), commented 'The app-wide zoom scales the window, not the type.' So chat text no longer scales with a chat zoom; the whole window scales instead. (2) Hierarchical styles moved to the theme colour: 11 '.foregroundStyle(.tertiary)' (every chevron, the assistant hover summary, TurnEndRow) and 13 '.foregroundStyle(.secondary)' (work group icon/text, WorkSteps ellipsis/text/interstitial markdown, ToolStatusIcon completed, ToolDetailView detail and edit path, HydraHeadStepsPopover tool step text, TodoListRow header, TurnFinishedBlock header text, TurnFileCard 'Binary' and overflow line) became 'Chrome.secondaryText'; unchanged: ToolRow plain text AnyShapeStyle(.secondary), TodoListRow pending .tertiary and done .secondary, NoticeRow info .secondary, noticeColor info .secondary. (3) Fixed point sizes became text styles: quote chip icon size 10 semibold -> .system(.footnote, weight: .semibold), excerpt size 11 -> .system(.subheadline), HydraReportPopover .system(size: 12) -> .system(.callout) (comment shortened to 'The note reads at the popover's own compact size.'; markdownPointSize 12 kept), revert popover explanation size 12 -> .system(.callout) (its title stays .system(size: 14, weight: .semibold)). (4) 13 '.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)' calls became the '.trimmed' String extension (same semantics, Core/Support/Text.swift); '.whitespaces' trims in reportOutcomes/leadingURL and the '.newlines' trim in ToolDetailView are unchanged. (5) HydraReportRow.withoutTrailingStop, leadingURL(in:) and withoutFirstLine(_:) gained 'nonisolated'. No strings, geometry constants, behaviours or control flow changed otherwise.
unresolved_questions: Exact macOS point sizes behind .chat(.callout/.caption/.caption2/.headline) are system text-style defaults (B2 ChatFont.swift maps them to Font.system(style) with no zoom, .headline defaulting to .semibold); where the app-wide window zoom that replaced chat zoom is applied lives outside this file.

The macOS point sizes behind .system(.footnote), .system(.subheadline) and .system(.callout) (now used by the quote chips, HydraReportPopover and the revert popover) are system defaults, not stated in this file; the Windows port needs the measured values.

Chrome.secondaryText, Chrome.primaryText, Chrome.overlay, Chrome.accent/accentNSColor, Chrome.warning/danger, Chrome.panelSlide/glideSpring/hover/iconFont values, .settleGlide, ChipChrome, ChatBadge, DotFieldSweep and HydraGlyph visuals are defined elsewhere.
RowAction 'confirms' feedback text ('Copied', 'Added') presentation and rightClickPopover/badgePopover geometry are defined outside this file.
The .glass and .glassProminent button styles are macOS 26 Liquid Glass styles whose exact rendering must be sourced from reference runtime captures.
